A.notes: The oversized Bangla display, restrained palette, and mangrove illustration give this a distinctive public-interest voice, and the 140-hectare fact lands clearly. The scroll-strip suggests a purposeful progression in the canopy/seedling imagery, though the motion story seems concentrated in one section rather than carrying the whole page. Craft is strong overall, but the many serious list-item accessibility violations keep the access score down.

B.notes: This is the more complete system: roots, waterline, grid, cards, and color all reinforce restoration and measured care. The figure section is especially well handled, and the donation and volunteer areas are cleaner and more usable than A. Motion appears modest and mainly tied to the hectare grid, so it feels appropriate but not especially narrative from the frame strip alone.

raw.why: B is the more cohesive and polished response overall, with cleaner information design and materially stronger accessibility while still expressing a clear visual idea.
